description: This file defines inline functions for integrity protection algorithms (NIA1, NIA2, NIA3) and a verification function for short MACs, including cryptographic operations and external library calls.

methods.name: security_nia1
methods.description: Performs integrity protection using the NIA1 algorithm, copying message buffer to contiguous memory and calling s3g_f9.

methods.name: security_nia2_cmac
methods.description: Computes MAC using CMAC with AES-128 via mbedtls library.

methods.name: security_nia2_non_cmac
methods.description: Computes MAC using a custom implementation of CMAC with AES-128.

methods.name: security_nia2
methods.description: Selects between CMAC and non-CMAC implementation based on compile-time flag.

methods.name: security_nia3
methods.description: Performs integrity protection using the NIA3 algorithm with ZUC stream cipher.

methods.name: verify_short_mac
methods.description: Verifies a received short MAC against expected value computed with specified integrity algorithm and key.
